interventions.title: Speed Humps

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters

interventions.title: Traffic Calming

interventions.title: Sidewalk Management

interventions.title: Daylighting

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Ensure adequate pedestrian-scale lighting is provided to improve safety and security at night.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Designated Bin Storage
interventions.description: Implement designated areas for trash and recycling bins to ensure the sidewalk remains clear and accessible for all users.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical deflection measures to reduce vehicle speeds to a level appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the ends of the block to improve visibility and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Consolidated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Provide designated off-sidewalk areas for trash and recycling to maintain the full effective width of the walkway.

interventions.title: Vertical Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or speed cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a vertical buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic while improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Designated Waste Collection Areas
interventions.description: Implementing standardized waste bins or designated collection points to prevent bags from obstructing the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to meet accessibility standards and provide a more comfortable walking environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Trim encroaching vegetation to restore the full width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Implement dedicated curb space for commercial loading to prevent large vehicles from obstructing sightlines or potentially blocking pedestrian walkways.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce local ordinances to keep the public right-of-way clear of trash and unauthorized temporary structures.
